# TestScript for 21-pluggable-types
# Verifies pluggable type bindings (app.Use), standard library types
# (*time.Location, syscall.Signal), slice parsing, and app.RegisterType
# with a completion predictor for foreign types

# 1. Default values
exec pluggable-demo
stdout '⚙  pluggable-demo'
stdout '-z, --tz\s+\*time\.Location\s+UTC\s+· default'
stdout '--replica-tz\s+\[\]\*time\.Location\s+—\s+○ unset'
stdout '-s, --signal\s+syscall\.Signal\s+terminated\s+· default'
stdout '--load\s+main\.Percent\s+0%\s+○ unset'

# 2. Parsing scalar pointer type and syscall.Signal
exec pluggable-demo -z Europe/London -s HUP
stdout '-z, --tz\s+\*time\.Location\s+Europe/London\s+● cli --tz'
stdout '-s, --signal\s+syscall\.Signal\s+hangup\s+● cli --signal'

# 3. Parsing slice of pointer types
exec pluggable-demo --replica-tz Europe/Paris,Asia/Tokyo
stdout '--replica-tz\s+\[\]\*time\.Location\s+\[Europe/Paris Asia/Tokyo\]\s+● cli --replica-tz'

# 4. RegisterType parser applies to the custom Percent type
exec pluggable-demo --load 75%
stdout '--load\s+main\.Percent\s+75%\s+● cli --load'

# 4b. The trailing percent sign is optional and the value renders canonically
exec pluggable-demo --load 75
stdout '--load\s+main\.Percent\s+75%\s+● cli --load'

# 5. The registered parser also reports coercion errors for the foreign type
exit-status 2 pluggable-demo --load 150%
stderr 'invalid load percentage "150%"'

# 5b. Signs, fractions, and a bare percent sign are rejected
exit-status 2 pluggable-demo --load +75%
stderr 'invalid load percentage "\+75%"'
exit-status 2 pluggable-demo --load 75.5%
stderr 'invalid load percentage "75\.5%"'
exit-status 2 pluggable-demo --load %
stderr 'invalid load percentage "%"'

# 6. WithPredictor attaches completion to the registered type
exec pluggable-demo __complete export --load ''
stdout '"value":"25%"'
stdout '"description":"High load"'
stdout '"value":"90%"'

# 7. Error on unknown timezone
exit-status 2 pluggable-demo -z Bogus/Location
stderr 'unknown time zone Bogus/Location'

# 8. Error on invalid signal
exit-status 2 pluggable-demo -s NOTASIGNAL
stderr 'invalid signal "NOTASIGNAL"'

# 9. Shell completion script generation
exec pluggable-demo --completion zsh
stdout '#compdef pluggable-demo'
